content: Ezetimibe/Simvastatin, marketed as VYTORIN, is supplied in various dosages and packaging configurations. Below are the detailed descriptions of the tablets and their respective packaging: 1. VYTORIN 10/10 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 311 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 tablets (NDC 66582-311-31) Bottles of 90 tablets (NDC 66582-311-54) Bottles of 1,000 tablets (NDC 66582-311-82). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Bottles of 10,000 tablets (NDC 66582-311-87). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Unit dose packages of 100 tablets (NDC 66582-311-28). 2. VYTORIN 10/20 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 312 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 tablets (NDC 66582-312-31) Bottles of 90 tablets (NDC 66582-312-54) Bottles of 1,000 tablets (NDC 66582-312-82). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Bottles of 10,000 tablets (NDC 66582-312-87). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Unit dose packages of 100 tablets (NDC 66582-312-28). 3. VYTORIN 10/40 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 313 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 tablets (NDC 66582-313-31) Bottles of 90 tablets (NDC 66582-313-54) Bottles of 500 tablets (NDC 66582-313-74). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Bottles of 5,000 tablets (NDC 66582-313-86). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Unit dose packages of 50 tablets (NDC 66582-313-52). 4. VYTORIN 10/80 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 315 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 tablets (NDC 66582-315-31) Bottles of 90 tablets (NDC 66582-315-54) Bottles of 500 tablets (NDC 66582-315-74). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Bottles of 2,500 tablets (NDC 66582-315-66). If repackaged into blisters, the blisters must be opaque or light-resistant. Unit dose packages of 50 tablets (NDC 66582-315-52). Storage Instructions: The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20-25°C (68-77°F). The container must remain tightly closed to protect the tablets from moisture and light. For large-count bottles (10,000 tablets for VYTORIN 10/10 and 10/20, 5,000 tablets for VYTORIN 10/40, and 2,500 tablets for VYTORIN 10/80): These should be stored in their original container until the time of use. If the product container is subdivided, the tablets must be repackaged into a tightly-closed, light-resistant container. The entire contents of the original container must be repackaged immediately upon opening to maintain product integrity.
